qualifications.qualification: All exact native cards, class-school rows and historical selection/source labels are preserved. Static authored acceptance is not acquisition in a campaign or enabling runtime catalog selection.

Test actors, real coordinates, maps, bodies, cargo and initial histories are explicit conditional fixtures. No actual campaign site, inventory, plane discovery, acquired character or human-play occurrence is established.

Unknown creature type, native plane, anatomy, geometry, supporting matter and equipment are not inferred. Only the explicitly stated conditional dimensions are used. Unavailable positive type/structure witnesses remain under the exact blockers.

Private source and plane identities remain director-only unless their source grants disclosure. No failure oracle, new cosmological plane, protected dossier, source copying right or retroactive undo is granted.
Only static authored data and independent read-only replay/integrity checks. No supplied/historical program, game engine or gameplay runtime was executed. Implementation remains unapproved.
No human playtest, numerical balance certification, encounter tuning or general gameplay safety claim.
Generated spell spaces are cast-owned identities, not canonical cosmological realms. All cosmology source locks and inherited research holds remain.
No whole-domain closure, ordinary-review completion, engine readiness or release approval. Live authority remains the submitted790/58 until independent application.
Transport6 and other accepted comparisons retain their exact recorded scope. New PG200 choices are local to these proposed spells. No feat or completed cohort is reopened.

All148 inherited hold records and current named blocker records including KR198-B01 are preserved unchanged. No disposition here resolves an outside identity; the next group waits for independent audit/application and refreshed authority.
